name: MS To Do
author: anishkn
description: Microsoft To Do tasks in your bar — quick-add with times and recurrence, keyboard-driven review, and desktop reminders so nothing slips

barWidget.description: Due-today count, quick-add, recurring tasks, timed reminders, focus timer

schema.label: Background sync
schema.description: How often open tasks refresh on their own. Opening the panel always syncs; this governs the idle case. Every tick is a couple of Graph requests per monitor.

schema.label: Max rows per section
schema.description: The panel scrolls past this; the cap keeps a bad week from becoming an endless popup.

schema.label: Undo window (seconds)
schema.description: Completions and deletions are held this long before being sent. 0 sends immediately with no undo.

schema.label: Desktop reminder lead
schema.description: Fire the desktop notification this many minutes before a task's reminder time. The phone is notified by the To Do app itself.

schema.label: List name
schema.description: Which To Do list to use. Empty uses your default list. Must match the display name exactly.

schema.label: Auto-start next phase
schema.description: When a focus block or break ends, start the next phase on its own instead of waiting for you to press play.

schema.label: Focus notifications
schema.description: Send a desktop toast when a focus block or break finishes.
